notes: All 13 snapshots (10 UBC Sauder alumni-by-year captures, 3 Kellogg job-market captures) are Common Crawl captures; sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each file footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp date. UBC Sauder pages (2008, 2009, 2011, 2012, 2016): titled "UBC PhD Alumni" with one sub-page per year. The page never states what the year means (graduation vs. placement); recorded as yearMeaning "unstated". Most plausibly the PhD completion/alumni year, but the integrator should confirm before treating it as graduation year. Columns are Name | Current University | Division (2008, 2009) or Specialization (2011, 2012, 2016). "Current University" is the affiliation at page date ("Last Updated on 9/20/2017"), so destination is NOT a first placement. Division/specialization codes are copied verbatim (SC, TLOG, MGSC are the operations/management-science-related codes; MIS, MKT, ACC, FIN, OB, SBE, ULE are other divisions). Empty Current University cells: Eran Rubin (2009), Landon Kleis (2011). UBC 2011: the two snapshots differ only for Ruodan Shao (University of Manitoba in the 2017-11-23 capture, York University in the 2018-11-13 capture); both rows kept. All other UBC pages are identical across their two captures. Kellogg job market candidates page: 2024-12-04 capture headed "2024-2025 Job Market Students" (recorded listedYear 2025); 2025-12-08 capture says "Information on our 2025-2026 job market students will be updated as it becomes available" (listedYear 2026); 2026-07-16 capture says "2026-2027" (listedYear 2027) and lists only two Marketing candidates, all other department tables empty at capture time. Degree recorded as PhD because the page describes the Doctoral Program as "PhD study"; the per-person rows do not state a degree. No placement destinations appear on this page (placements are on a separate "job placements" page not in this chunk). Kellogg items to double-check: Xiaojie Liu (Managerial Economics & Strategy) appears on both the 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 lists; Andres Espitia (MEDS, 2025-2026 list) has "Adjunct Professor / MEDS" printed in his name cell, which may indicate a current adjunct title rather than a placement. Operations-relevant rows for this project: UBC SC/TLOG/MGSC codes (Binyamin Mantin, Fredrik Odegaard 2008; Mariel Lavieri, Chi Lok (Andrew) Yuen 2009; Hangjun (Gavin) Yang 2011; Qu (Alex) Qian 2012; Reza Skandari 2016) and the Kellogg Operations Management tables (Vikas Deep, Alejandro Hernández De la Lanza, Angela Kohlenberg, Partha Mishra for 2024-2025; Himani Ananthula, Yudi Huang, Yao Li, Deniz Simsek for 2025-2026).
